description: Voigtländer于1939年推出的折叠相机。配备Voigtar 75mm f/3.5, Vaskar 75mm f/4.5 (Post-war), Skopar or Color-Skopar (Post-War) 75mm f/3.5, or Color Heliar 75mm f/3.5。使用twelve 6×6cm exposures on 120 film。

specs.镜头: Voigtar 75mm f/3.5, Vaskar 75mm f/4.5 (Post-war), Skopar or Color-Skopar (Post-War) 75mm f/3.5, or Color Heliar 75mm f/3.5
specs.取景器: Sports finder in most models, and optical-viewfinder in "Deluxe" models
specs.英文简介: The Bessa 66 is a folding 120 rollfilm camera made in Germany by Voigtländer, it was introduced in 1938 as a 6x6 image camera.
